title: 水下科學機械手
summary: 以民用取樣機械手模型區分浮力、關節力矩、抓取力和視覺延遲，建立不傷樣本的判讀流程。 在水下科學取樣機械手模擬室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Separate buoyancy, joint torque, grip and visual latency in a civilian sampling-arm model. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Underwater scientific sampling-arm simulator. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 取樣工具與關節力臂：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sampling-tool joint lever arm: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 取樣工具與關節力臂 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sampling-tool joint lever arm and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「水下科學機械手」的「取樣工具與關節力臂」中，準靜態機械臂扭矩由負載力乘垂直力臂。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以民用取樣機械手模型區分浮力、關節力矩、抓取力和視覺延遲，建立不傷樣本的判讀流程。
steps.instructionEn: Within Underwater scientific manipulators, Sampling-tool joint lever arm examines this mechanism: Quasistatic manipulator torque equals load force times perpendicular lever arm. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Separate buoyancy, joint torque, grip and visual latency in a civilian sampling-arm model.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：負載F=40 N，力臂r=0.25 m。關係式 τ=Fr；含單位換算算式 40*0.25 = 10 N·m。適用條件：僅單關節靜態，不含浮力、慣性或水動阻力。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Load force 40 N and perpendicular lever arm 0.25 m. Relation τ=Fr; expression including unit conversion 40*0.25 = 10 N·m. Applicability: Single-joint statics; buoyancy, inertia and fluid drag excluded.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：以空氣中重量代替水中有效負載會錯估關節扭矩。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Air weight instead of submerged effective load misestimates joint torque. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「取樣工具與關節力臂」，把重力、浮力和工具接觸力分別畫在自由體圖。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Sampling-tool joint lever arm, Draw gravity, buoyancy and tool-contact forces separately. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.text: 在「取樣工具與關節力臂」比較基準算式 40*0.25 與替代算式 40*0.35。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 14 N·m，與基準 10 N·m 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。

Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「水下科學機械手」的「取樣工具與關節力臂：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Sampling-tool joint lever arm: Mechanism and observation” in “Underwater scientific manipulators”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
